title: South Korea Has Four Times America's Robot Density
hook: The factory automation leader is not the country installing the most robots.
closing: Robot density reveals how completely automation has entered each factory workforce.
question: Would you want a robot coworker?

segments.say: South Korea has 1,220 robots per ten thousand factory workers. No other country is as automated per worker.
America has 307 robots per ten thousand workers. South Korea's density is nearly four times higher.
China has 166 robots per ten thousand workers despite installing the most. South Korea still leads where workers feel automation.
